text:
lina-sales: Heads up — Nexera (healthcare SaaS) is evaluating a hybrid reserved + burst setup. They want guidance on blended per-token pricing, whether pre-purchased credits can apply to reserved usage, and how overages would be billed. They need an answer for a procurement call next Tue.
anya: Thanks — a few clarifying Qs: what sustained throughput do they expect, and how large are the spikes? Also what target per-token are they proposing?
matt-eng: FYI: our dedicated pools support burst routing to hosted. Need to confirm fallback latency SLOs if we route to hosted; quantization/profile choices will change per-token cost materially.
lina-sales: Their ask: 2x A100-equiv reserved; sustained ~600 reqs/min, daily spikes ~3-4x lasting 30–90m. Current hosted spend ~$120k/mo. They asked for a blended target around $0.0008/token for committed+burst, and would pre-purchase ~200M tokens/month as credits for burst.
anya: Important: are they insisting those prepaid credits cover both reserved and hosted fallback? Our accounting currently treats reserved commit as a flat capacity fee + separate overage billing.
lina-sales: Procurement prefers credits that can offset total usage (simpler for them) — they'd push back if credits only apply to hosted fallback.
sam: Billing ops notes — current models supported:
- Option A: Monthly reserved commit (flat) + separate prepaid hosted credits used only when routing to hosted fallback.
- Option B: Blended per-token discount across total tokens (committed + burst) requiring amortization of reserved fee into unit price and billing system changes.
Option B needs finance signoff; more complex but nicer for the customer.
billing-bot: <link to billing playbook: https://redwood.internal/billing/pricing-patterns>
anya: Recommended next steps: intake this as a P2 pricing request. We need three artifacts from sales before product can model economics:
1) 30-day token histogram (per-minute or per-hour) showing spike distribution
2) Contract term preference (12/24/36mo) and minimum annual commit
3) Required latency & availability SLOs for both reserved pool and fallback
Acceptance criteria for a proposal: clear blended and per-path pricing options, modeled unit economics (margin impact), and an operational plan for routing + billing changes. Owner: @anya. Target: draft proposal by EOD Friday.
lina-sales: 👍 I'll pull the histogram and confirm term. Will also ask Nexera if they'd accept Option A fallback semantics as a negotiation starting point.
sam: I'll scope the billing system changes and estimate ETA. Finance: need @maria-fin to weigh in on allowable discount depth if we do blending.
maria-fin: Quick note — to keep target margins we need to maintain >=25% margin on modeled run rate. If customer wants $0.0008 blended, we need to ensure the commit size or term length supports it; otherwise recommend a smaller discount or require larger annual commitment.
anya: I'll create the intake doc and link the PR/epic. Adding labels: pricing-request, sales-intake, reserved-hybrid. Intake doc: https://redwood.atlassian/PRJ-4321
lina-sales: Thanks — I'll add Nexera's answers once I have them and tag @anya.
